 Sony Pictures Networks acquires ‘Hanuman Ansh’ for Sony LIV and Sony MAX
 Inspired by Neem Karoli Baba’s life, the faith-based film arrives on Sony LIV on 27 November
 Published
 1 hour ago on
 November 7, 2026 
 By
 indiantelevision.com Team 
 Follow us on Google News 
 Follow us on WhatsApp 
 Share 
 Tweet 
 MUMBAI: Faith finds a new screen. Sony Pictures Networks India has acquired the digital and television rights to Hanuman Ansh , a film inspired by the life and spiritual journey of Neem Karoli Baba, expanding its slate of devotional and faith-based content.
 The film will premiere on Sony LIV on 27 November, followed by a television debut on Sony MAX on a date yet to be announced.
 Positioned as an emotionally driven story rooted in devotion and human values, Hanuman Ansh follows Lakshminarayan, a young boy who embarks on a quest to find God. The narrative traces his transformation, drawing inspiration from the life and teachings of Neem Karoli Baba, the revered spiritual figure associated with devotion to Lord Hanuman.
 The acquisition gives Sony Pictures Networks India rights across both its digital and linear television platforms, allowing the film to reach audiences beyond its existing global viewership.
 The network said the film had struck an emotional chord with audiences across the world, prompting its addition to the content portfolio. Its arrival on Sony LIV will give streaming audiences the first opportunity to watch the story, before it moves to the television screen on Sony MAX.
 With the acquisition, Sony Pictures Networks India is extending its content offering beyond mainstream entertainment, tapping into stories centred on faith, spirituality and timeless human values.
 For Hanuman Ansh , the next chapter is now set to unfold across Indian screens, bringing its story of devotion to a wider audience.
